fields.name: client_id
fields.help: App Key of your DHgate Open Platform application (https://open.dhgate.com/console); the Dropshipping/buyer APIs must be granted to the app (API authorization level A, no public network access).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: App Secret of the application, sent in the refresh_token grant to https://secure.dhgate.com/dop/oauth2/access_token.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from the DHgate BUYER account's authorization-code consent (https://secure.dhgate.com/dop/oauth2/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=…&scope=basic, then grant_type=authorization_code). It is valid 30 days; the runtime mints 1-day access tokens from it and keeps the refresh_token each response returns (set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to persist it).

me.note: dh.buyer.user.get v2.0 (GET https://api.dhgate.com/dop/router?method=…&v=2.0&timestamp=<ms>&access_token=…): {status{code '00000000', message}, buyerId, buyerName, email, country, buyerType, userTypeBase}. Router failures such as an unknown app key answer HTTP 200 {code, message} (e.g. 23 'Invalid App Key', 40 expired Access Token), reported as errors.

list_products.note: dh.dropshipping.item.list v1.0: pages (1-based), pageSize (at most 60), itemNameKeyWords, dispCategoryId (display category id from dh.dropshipping.dispcategory.list). Rows {itemCode, itemName, supplierid, minBuyerPrice/maxBuyerPrice (original), dealMinBuyerPrice/dealMaxBuyerPrice (actual sale price), imgUrl (a DHgate image path), cateDispId, isFreeShip (0 = free shipping, 1 = not), confirmQty}. Prices are in USD (the currency parameter is not sent). The response's total/pageTotal are strings and are not returned.

get_product.note: dh.dropshipping.item.get v1.0 (itemCode): itemName, currency, dhgateProductUrl, itemImgList[{imgUrl, mainImg}], itemPackage (grossWeight kg, cm dimensions), itemAttrList, itemSkuList[{skuId, skuMD5, minBuyerPrice, dealMinBuyerPrice, retailPrice, inventory, saleStatus, itemPriceRangeList, itemSkuAttrValueList, itemSkuInventoryList[{inventoryLocation, skuInventoryQty}]}]. price and stock are the FIRST SKU's; every SKU is in raw.itemSkuList (create_order needs the chosen skuMD5). Error 108 means a wrong itemCode.

quote_shipping.note: dh.dropshipping.ship.get v1.0 (itemCode, country ISO-2 e.g. US/FR, quantity; stocking country CN by default): shipCostAndWayList[{expressType (e.g. ePacket, pass as the item's shipType in create_order), shipcost, currency, deliveryTime ('8-30' days), shipTimeMin/Max, isfreeShipping, stockCountryId}].

create_order.note: dh.buyer.order.place v2.0 (POST, form fields cartList and contactInfo as JSON strings). Pass `items` in DHgate's CartInfo shape: [{itemcode, skuMd5 (from get_product raw.itemSkuList), quantity, shipType (expressType from quote_shipping, optional), stockin (optional, default CN)}], and `shipping_address` in BuyerContactInfo shape: {firstname, lastname, country (ISO-2), state, city, addressline1, addressline2, postalcode, tel, email, vatNumber (mandatory for BR)}; both are sent as given. The answer lists one order per seller (orderList[{orderInfo{id (the order No.), orderTotal, shipCost, createTime (epoch ms)}}]); `id` is the FIRST order's number (every order is in raw of that first entry only; see get_order). Placed orders are paid separately (dh.buyer.order.pay, not mapped).

get_order.note: dh.buyer.order.get v2.0 (orderNo, the numeric order No., not the hexadecimal order id): orderStatus codes 101003 awaiting payment, 102001 paid awaiting confirmation, 103001 awaiting shipment, 103002 partially shipped, 101009 awaiting receipt confirmation, 102111 completed, 111000 cancelled, 111111 closed, 105xxx/106xxx refund and dispute states. Dates are 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' (Beijing time); amounts are USD (no currency field). tracking_number is the first orderDeliveryList entry's deliveryNo.

not_offered.track: No tracking-events call: dh.buyer.trade.order.status.get (https://open.dhgate.com/docs/api/detail/fab4906ab8014172935302925706bea3) and dh.buyer.trade.deliveryno.get return only the order status and deliveryNo, 'Format: [transport mode: shipping No.; ...]. Example: UPS:DY0124,DHL:301245' (one string, no events); the shipping numbers are already in get_order.
